## 1. I ntroduction

SETU is committed to the efficient use of all energy across all campuses and activities with the purposes of reducing carbon emissions, optimising energy efficiency, mitigating the effects of climate change and preserving natural resources.

The Climate Action and Low Carbon Development (Amendment) Act 2021, requires all public bodies including SETU,  to align with national climate goals which are currently 50% Energy Efficiency improvement, against a 2006 to 2008 baseline and an absolute carbon reduction of 51% against an average of 2016 to 2018 baseline by 2030 1 .

## 2. Purpose

The purpose of this Energy Policy is to support and integrate with our broader energy  management system, ensuring alignment with the international energy management standard ISO 50001:2018.

## 3. Scope

This Policy applies to all students, employees (whether employed on a permanent, fixed term or temporary contract), trainees, seconded staff, agency staff, consultants, or third parties acting on behalf of or engaged by the University. It is the responsibility of:

- all students, employees, and relevant parties as outlined above, involved in energy consumption to familiarise themselves with the content of this Policy and to adhere to the expected standards; and
- all infrastructure Building design teams (in accordance with their Conditions of Engagement) will be required to comply with this Policy and to inform all relevant associated parties of the requirements to comply with this Policy.

The Policy shall be made generally available and published publicly via the University website.

## 4. Principles

The  guiding  principles  of  this  energy  policy  as  part  of  ISO50001:2018  require that the policy:

- is appropriate to the purpose of the organisation;
- provides a framework for setting and reviewing objectives and energy targets;
